build_ctc_graph: build a CTC graph from a target label sequence and blank symbol index for sequence modeling
create_emissions_graph: create an emissions graph from a vector of emission probabilities with time steps and label dimensions
test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion loss computation and gradient verification against known expected values
test_asg_criterion: test the Align-and-Score criterion loss computation and gradient verification against known expected values
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the Viterbi path decoding over composed emissions and transition graphs
